title: ReferralLinkCreated
description: A provider created a referral link or QR. Since 1.11.0 the Clinic delivers it to Kiorex through its outbox with the organisation reference (`orgRef`), so the link registry knows a code before its first signed token. Link code, scope, channel and organisation reference only: never patient data.

linkCode.description: 8 Crockford base32 characters (no I, L, O, U); ARCH section 4.2.

orgRef.description: Organisation (tenant) reference that owns the link code; the same value the signed `lt` carries as `o`. Additive in 1.11.0 on ReferralLinkCreated (optional there); required on ReferralLinkRevoked.

clinicRef.description: Clinic the link belongs to, when scoped to one. Additive in 1.11.0.

product.description: Product the link or fact belongs to. Absent means CLINIC (1.11.0 behaviour). Additive in 1.12.0.

aggregateType.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.

aggregateId.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.
